observations: A head close-up with a natural small neck/shoulder, without the rejected full body or human-looking torso.
Connected brown/gold facets, one open eye and a wink, plain muzzle, and a single mouth-held multicolored flower sprig.
Native left ear, right horn, and right ear reach the image boundary; shrinking alone would expose flat source cuts. Preserve the accepted face while addressing edge completion and placement together.
